security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Local push-to-talk voice transcription with AI cleanup.
bundle.longDescription: VibeToText is a cross-platform push-to-talk dictation app. It records audio via a global hotkey, transcribes locally with whisper.cpp, optionally cleans up or restructures the text with Gemini, and auto-pastes the result. Includes a history dashboard with VADER sentiment analytics and a transparent waveform overlay.
